body: Could we make the welcome heading clearer?
reply: I will try a shorter heading.

body: The project status should remain visible while scrolling the summary.
reply: I moved the status beside the project name.

body: Can we group pinned repositories before the rest of the list?
reply: Pinned repositories now appear in their own section.

body: The review status needs a text label as well as a color.
reply: Each pull request now includes a review status label.

body: Could the issue summary show the assignee and milestone together?
reply: Both fields now appear below the issue title.

body: Keep the accepted answer easy to find in a long discussion.
reply: The accepted answer is linked from the discussion header.

body: The team overview could use a clearer ownership summary.
reply: I added the team owners and a link to their responsibilities.

body: Please include the release date beside the version.
reply: Release dates are now shown in the list and details.
